theme.description: Premium Fintech & Banking Dashboard. Emphasizes authority, trust, and clarity through a hybrid of 'Organic & Earthy' (Wealth) and 'Swiss High-Contrast'. The interface is primarily crisp off-white with dark emerald green accents to convey financial security.

typography.instructions: Use Manrope for all headings (H1-H6) with tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) to give a modern, structured look. Use IBM Plex Sans for all body text, tables, numbers, and currency (INR ₹), as it has excellent tabular lining features perfect for financial data. NEVER use Inter.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Rely heavily on 1px solid borders (border-gray-200) rather than large muddy shadows. Use subtle shadow-sm for cards to lift them slightly off the #F9FAFB background. Use shadow-lg for dropdowns/modals.
visual_enhancers.borders: rounded-xl for large containers (cards, modals), rounded-md for interactive elements (buttons, inputs). All cards should have a delicate 1px border.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating navs, use bg-white/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and a subtle border-b border-gray-200. NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds over content.

components.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#064E3B] text-white hover:bg-[#047857]. Shape: rounded-lg. Add micro-interaction: active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform.
components.inputs: Clean, structured inputs with white backgrounds, border-gray-300, and focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#064E3B]/20. No floating labels; use clear, strong labels above inputs.
components.cards: Dashboard widgets should be card-based with p-6 or p-8 padding to ensure breathing room. No generic gradients inside data cards.
components.tables: Crucial for banking: Data tables must have left-aligned text and right-aligned currency values. Use subtle striped rows (even:bg-gray-50) or distinct bottom borders (border-b border-gray-100) per row. High contrast header row (e.g., bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 font-semibold).

layouts.dashboard: High Density Dashboard Grid. Use a dark sidebar (bg-slate-900 text-white) to create a striking contrast against the light main content area (bg-[#F9FAFB]). The main area should use a Bento Grid approach for summary metrics.
layouts.auth: Split-screen layout for login/register. Left side: Full-bleed architectural/finance image with a bg-black/40 overlay. Right side: Clean, centered, heavily padded white login form container.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8 for card internals. gap-6 or gap-8 for dashboard grids.

motion.interactions: Provide immediate visual feedback. Hover states on table rows (hover:bg-gray-50). Button scale down on click.
motion.charts: Use Recharts. Animate line drawing and bar growth on load for a polished feel.
motion.restrictions: DO NOT use 'transition-all'. Specify properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform) to prevent transform breakage.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use pale gray text on white backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, forms, and key data points MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='transfer-submit-button', data-testid='user-balance').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all focusable elements (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-700 focus:outline-none).

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for clean, consistent standard icons.
media.charts: Use 'recharts'. LineChart for monthly transaction trends (smooth curve, deep green line). BarChart for transaction types.

login_hero.description: Modern high-rise bank architecture. Use for Auth layout split-screen background.

security_vault.description: Secure vault knob. Use for security/admin layout flair or empty states for locked accounts.

abstract_data.description: Abstract blue data background. Can be used for admin dashboard hero or transaction analysis headers.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (using shadows and crisp borders).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, but NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds where content sits below.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). It breaks transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like robot, brain, lightbulb) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use .js/.jsx extensions for React files. Do not use .tsx.
Use standard HTML inputs for basic forms, but Shadcn UI components for complex interactions. Customize them with Tailwind.
Currency must be formatted in INR (₹) and numbers styled nicely with IBM Plex Sans.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have a 'data-testid' attribute for robust automated testing.
